turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting clamping unit diagnostic procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Inspect the clamping arm bodies for cracks or bending deformation. Check each pivot pin boss for looseness by attempting to rock the arm, and inspect the clamping pad faces for wear beyond the minimum thickness.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the clamping arm bodies for cracks or bending deformation. 2. Check each pivot pin boss for looseness by attempting to rock the arm. 3. Inspect the clamping pad faces for wear beyond the minimum thickness.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Visual inspection complete. All clamping arm bodies are free of cracks and deformation, pivot bosses are secure, and pad thickness is within spec.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the clamping arm bodies for cracks or bending deformation. 2. Check each pivot pin boss for looseness by attempting to rock the arm. 3. Inspect the clamping pad faces for wear beyond the minimum thickness.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are there any cracks, deformation, or severe wear on the clamping arms?

ground_truth.node_text: Cracks, deformation or severe wear on clamping arms?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the arms are structurally sound with no visible damage or excessive wear.

ground_truth.node_text: Cracks, deformation or severe wear on clamping arms?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the clamping force within plus or minus five percent of the rated value?

ground_truth.node_text: Clamping force within ±5% of rated value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the measured force is about eight percent below the rated value at multiple stations.

ground_truth.node_text: Clamping force within ±5% of rated value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Replace the return springs and check the actuator seals for integrity.

ground_truth.node_text: Replace return springs and check actuator seals

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Return springs replaced and actuator seals inspected. Seals appear intact.

ground_truth.node_text: Replace return springs and check actuator seals

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the clamping force after spring replacement. Has the force returned to specification?

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify clamping force after spring replacement

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The force improved slightly but is still reading low, about six percent below rated.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify clamping force after spring replacement

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Perform secondary spring set replacement. Remove all clamping springs, verify the spring seat surfaces are clean and undamaged, then install new springs from the correct specification batch. Confirm the free length of each spring matches the specification before installation, and cycle the clamp five times after replacement to allow the springs to seat.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary spring set replacement: remove all clamping springs and verify the spring seat surfaces are clean and undamaged before fitting. Install new springs from the correct specification batch, confirming the free length of each spring matches the specification before installation. Cycle the clamp five times after replacement to allow the springs to seat before returning to the clamping force measurement step.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Secondary spring set installed, all free lengths verified against spec. Clamp cycled five times and springs are seated.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary spring set replacement: remove all clamping springs and verify the spring seat surfaces are clean and undamaged before fitting. Install new springs from the correct specification batch, confirming the free length of each spring matches the specification before installation. Cycle the clamp five times after replacement to allow the springs to seat before returning to the clamping force measurement step.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the clamping force after the secondary spring replacement. Has the force returned to specification?

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify clamping force after spring replacement

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, clamping force is now within specification at all stations.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify clamping force after spring replacement

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the clamp pad surface condition acceptable?

ground_truth.node_text: Clamp pad surface condition acceptable?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the surface roughness reading is above the maximum permitted value and flatness is out of tolerance at two corners.

ground_truth.node_text: Clamp pad surface condition acceptable?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Replace the clamp pad and apply the correct torque to the retaining screws.

ground_truth.node_text: Replace clamp pad, apply correct torque to retaining screws

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: New clamp pad installed and retaining screws torqued to specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Replace clamp pad, apply correct torque to retaining screws

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Command the clamp to the fully open position and measure the gap between the pad face and the reference surface using a digital caliper. Then close the clamp fully and probe the closed position sensor at its trigger point using a feeler gauge to measure the sensor actuation gap. Compare both values against the tolerance ranges on the clamp setup drawing.

ground_truth.node_text: Command the clamp to the fully open position and measure the gap between the pad face and the reference surface using a digital caliper; compare against the nominal open position dimension. Close the clamp fully and probe the closed position sensor at its trigger point using a feeler gauge to measure the sensor actuation gap. Both values must fall within the tolerance ranges on the clamp setup drawing.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Open position gap measured at twenty-three point four millimeters, closed sensor actuation gap at one point eight millimeters.

ground_truth.node_text: Command the clamp to the fully open position and measure the gap between the pad face and the reference surface using a digital caliper; compare against the nominal open position dimension. Close the clamp fully and probe the closed position sensor at its trigger point using a feeler gauge to measure the sensor actuation gap. Both values must fall within the tolerance ranges on the clamp setup drawing.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are the open and close sensor positions within plus or minus zero point three millimeters of nominal?

ground_truth.node_text: Open and close sensor positions within ±0.3 mm of nominal?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the open position is point five millimeters out of nominal.

ground_truth.node_text: Open and close sensor positions within ±0.3 mm of nominal?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reposition the sensors and reteach the open and close positions in the programmable controller.

ground_truth.node_text: Reposition sensors and reteach open/close positions in programmable controller

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Sensors repositioned and positions retaught in the controller.

ground_truth.node_text: Reposition sensors and reteach open/close positions in programmable controller

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the sensor positions after reteach. Are they now within tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify sensor positions after reteach

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, both open and close positions are now within the point three millimeter tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify sensor positions after reteach

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the pivot pin radial clearance within the zero point zero five millimeter limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Pivot pin radial clearance within 0.05 mm limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, radial clearance measured at zero point zero three millimeters, well within the limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Pivot pin radial clearance within 0.05 mm limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are all pivot points correctly lubricated?

ground_truth.node_text: All pivot points correctly lubricated?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all nipples accepted grease properly and pivot points are lubricated per specification.

ground_truth.node_text: All pivot points correctly lubricated?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Were all twenty cycles completed without missed clamp or timeout?

ground_truth.node_text: All 20 cycles completed without missed clamp or timeout?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, cycle fourteen timed out and the clamp failed to reach the fully closed position.

ground_truth.node_text: All 20 cycles completed without missed clamp or timeout?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Investigate the cycle fault and check sensor and actuator timing.

ground_truth.node_text: Investigate cycle fault, check sensor and actuator timing

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Fault traced to a delayed sensor signal. Timing adjusted and fault cleared.

ground_truth.node_text: Investigate cycle fault, check sensor and actuator timing

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Load the reference part into the fixture and close the clamp to production pressure. Attempt to move the reference part by applying a lateral force by hand, then confirm the part does not move and record the clamping force reading.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Load the reference part into the fixture and close the clamp to production pressure. 2. Attempt to move the reference part by applying a lateral force by hand. 3. Confirm the part does not move and record the clamping force reading.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Reference part loaded and clamp closed. Applied lateral force but part remained secure. Force reading recorded.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Load the reference part into the fixture and close the clamp to production pressure. 2. Attempt to move the reference part by applying a lateral force by hand. 3. Confirm the part does not move and record the clamping force reading.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Was the reference part held without movement during the simulated cut?

ground_truth.node_text: Reference part held without movement during simulated cut?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the part shifted slightly under the applied force.

ground_truth.node_text: Reference part held without movement during simulated cut?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log the clamp force and cycle data, and update the service record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log clamp force and cycle data, update service record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All data logged and service record updated with today's findings.

ground_truth.node_text: Log clamp force and cycle data, update service record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. Note the part movement issue in the production log and monitor clamping performance closely during the next production run.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, I'll document the issue and keep watch on the clamp during production.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

issues.original: The part shifted slightly under force, indicating insufficient clamping at the current pressure setting.
issues.corrected: No, the part shifted slightly under the applied force.
issues.explanation: The operator's response at box_30 (decision node) should directly answer the question 'Was the reference part held without movement during the simulated cut?' with a simple 'No'. The original utterance adds interpretive commentary about pressure settings that goes beyond answering the decision point and introduces analysis that may not be warranted at this stage of the procedure.
